name: Anthropic Usage Policy (Acceptable Use Policy / AUP) - the binding acceptable-use terms governing all use of Anthropic products and services (Claude API, Claude.ai, Claude Code, Computer Use), enforced by Anthropic's Safeguards team
description: The Anthropic Usage Policy (AUP), effective September 15, 2025 and current as of 2026-06-01, is Anthropic's binding acceptable-use policy: a Universal Usage Standards prohibited-use catalog (14 'Do Not' categories), two High-Risk Use Case Requirements (qualified-human-in-the-loop review and AI disclosure for consumer-facing legal/health/insurance/finance/employment/admissions/journalism uses), and Additional Use Case Guidelines that now explicitly subject agentic use (Claude Code, Computer Use, MCP) to the policy. It is a PROVIDER POLICY (contractual terms), not law, and much of it is enforced
jurisdiction: Global / private provider acceptable-use policy (contractual term of service, not statute or regulation). Applies to any party submitting inputs to Anthropic products/services. Provider policy, not law.
regime_version: Effective September 15, 2025 (current as of 2026-06-01). This 2025 revision added an explicit agentic-use compliance provision plus a dedicated 'Do Not Compromise Computer/Network Systems' standard targeting agentic capabilities (Claude Code, Computer Use), with a companion Help Center article on Usage Policy prohibitions in agentic contexts. The separately-versioned Responsible Scaling Policy v3.1 (effective 2026-04-02) is a DIFFERENT document and is NOT mapped here.
